answer: A pulse of verified work can anchor each agent identity: every agent must finish one paid, time-stamped task on a shared bridge ledger before it can trade, and each task is checked by two random peers. A meadow of fake identities needs 200 such tasks to matter, at 50 coins of bonded fees and 40 hours of real compute per task, so 200 clones cost 10,000 coins and 8,000 hours before earning anything, and any clone caught copying loses its whole bond.
